WITH cand AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id, a.asn, a.org
  FROM incidents i
  JOIN ip_asn_cache c ON (c.first_ip <= i.src_ip::inet AND c.last_ip >= i.src_ip::inet)
  JOIN scanner_asn a ON a.asn = c.asn
  WHERE i.status = 'OPEN' AND i.src_ip <> '' AND i.risk_score < 40
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id AND e.outcome = 'failed_login')
),
closed AS (
  UPDATE incidents SET status = 'CLOSED_FP',
    analyst_note = ('auto-close (scanner ASN ' || c.asn || ' ' || c.org || ')'),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM cand c WHERE incidents.incident_id = c.incident_id
  RETURNING incidents.incident_id, c.asn, c.org
)
INSERT INTO analyst_decisions (incident_id, verdict, analyst, note)
SELECT incident_id, 'FP', 'asn-autoclose',
  ('scanner ASN ' || asn || ' ' || org || ' - deterministic auto-close, risk<40, failed_login-only')
FROM closed
RETURNING incident_id;

WITH ti_norm AS (
  SELECT incident_id,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ti_summary) = 'array' THEN ti_summary
         WHEN jsonb_typeof(ti_summary) = 'object' THEN jsonb_build_array(ti_summary)
         ELSE '[]'::jsonb END AS arr
  FROM incidents WHERE status = 'OPEN'
),
ti_hot AS (
  SELECT incident_id FROM ti_norm, jsonb_array_elements(arr) t
  WHERE CASE WHEN (t->'sources'->'virustotal'->>'malicious') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
             THEN (t->'sources'->'virustotal'->>'malicious')::int ELSE 0 END > 0
     OR CASE WHEN (t->'sources'->'otx'->>'pulses') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
             THEN (t->'sources'->'otx'->>'pulses')::int ELSE 0 END > 0
     OR COALESCE(t->'sources'->'urlhaus'->>'threat', '') <> ''
),
cand AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id,
    CASE WHEN i.src_ip LIKE '%.amazonaws.com' THEN i.src_ip
         ELSE (SELECT e.raw->'observables'->>'src_host' FROM soc_events e
               WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id
                 AND (e.raw->'observables'->>'src_host') LIKE '%.amazonaws.com'
               ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 1) END AS endpoint,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id) AS nevents
  FROM incidents i
  WHERE i.status = 'OPEN' AND i.risk_score < 40
    AND (COALESCE(i.src_ip, '') = '' OR i.src_ip LIKE '%.amazonaws.com')
    AND (i.src_ip LIKE '%.amazonaws.com'
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id
                 AND (e.raw->'observables'->>'src_host') LIKE '%.amazonaws.com'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id
                    AND COALESCE(e.src_ip, '') <> '' AND e.src_ip NOT LIKE '%.amazonaws.com')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ti_hot h WHERE h.incident_id = i.incident_id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id
                    AND NOT ((e.raw->'observables'->>'event_name') IN ('AssumeRole', 'LookupEvents')
                      OR (e.raw->'observables'->>'event_name') LIKE 'Describe%'
                      OR (e.raw->'observables'->>'event_name') LIKE 'List%'
                      OR (e.raw->'observables'->>'event_name') LIKE 'Get%'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id
                    AND COALESCE(e.raw->'observables'->>'error_code', '') <> '')
),
closed AS (
  UPDATE incidents SET status = 'CLOSED_FP',
    analyst_note = ('auto-close (AWS service endpoint ' || c.endpoint || ', ' || c.nevents || ' event(s), TI cold, read-only)'),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM cand c WHERE incidents.incident_id = c.incident_id
  RETURNING incidents.incident_id, c.endpoint, c.nevents
)
INSERT INTO analyst_decisions (incident_id, verdict, analyst, note)
SELECT incident_id, 'FP', 'aws-service-autoclose',
  ('AWS service endpoint ' || endpoint || ' - deterministic auto-close, TI cold, read-only, no error, risk<40')
FROM closed
RETURNING incident_id;
